caption:
Bokchoy Soup
soup recipe | vegan 

Nutrition: 
C: 9 | F: 8 | P: 4
Calories: 114 per serve 
Serves 3

Ingredients
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger
50 grams button mushroom, sliced 
3 1/2 cups vegetable stock OR 1 stock cube + water 
500 grams bokchoy, chopped
1 tsp black pepper
salt, to taste if needed 

Method
in a pan, add oil along with garlic and ginger and saute
add in mushroom and cook for a few minutes
add in stock + bokchoy and let it cook for a few more minutes 
then pepper goes in and its ready 

can be kept in the fridge for 2-3 days
